integrity: A complete universal proof and exact finite contact census are provided with standalone reproducible verification. Self-review passed; independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed directed contacts, exactly one generation of infectiousness, one initial infection and one perfect pre-epidemic vaccination.
Counting the seed generation in peak; seven-edge polynomial requires independent equal contact probabilities.
Full text of Floyd–Kay–Shapiro (2008) not inspected; stronger graph-theoretic literature may cover the result.
No clinical/general-network intervention recommendation or independent external validation.
title: The seven-person threshold for vaccination-induced epidemic peak amplification
